about: Squares no castle, mine or teleport may use: every sea and off-realm cell of Grok's realm map v25, and every city square (generated by tools/realm/build_realm.py - never hand-edit; re-run it). Keys are cellKey "x,y" (col,row) on the 1000x596 (cols x rows) grid.
source: land/sea mask of the realm art (Grok landalpha water rule), a cell is land when >= 50% of it is land; a cell is city when > 30% of it is a city overlay's opaque pixels (alpha >= 128)
